photos.name: img-6808
photos.summary: Assembled pepperoni pizza on a wooden peel, pre-bake. Stretched dough topped with sauce, shredded mozzarella, and pepperoni slices, with a clean raised cornicione visible around the edge.

photos.name: img-6810
photos.summary: Stretched dough on a wooden peel with sauce spread in a spiral, pre-topping. A small bowl of grated parmesan and a microplane grater sit on the counter alongside a bowl of sauce.

photos.name: img-6812
photos.summary: Sliced pepperoni pizza with a piece held up to show the crumb cross-section — dense, tight crumb with minimal air pockets. Significant charring visible along the crust edges and bottom, with cupped pepperoni on top.

photos.name: img-6814
photos.summary: Close-up of a finished pepperoni pizza showing heavy char on the crust rim and cheese surface with scattered dark blisters. Pepperoni pieces partially buried under melted, browned cheese.
